name: Solaris Rooftop 01
description: A 5 kW rooftop array, represented in this pilot by a 6 V / 250 mA model panel whose output is scaled ×3,333. Every reading is signed by the meter on site and settled on Solana.

name: Eshan Rooftop
description: A demo project driven by a software meter so payouts keep flowing at night or on cloudy days. Same program, same proofs, same checks as the real project.
